terra.problem: The joke about God checking His schedule puts God in a joke.
The verse says he forgets to eat his bread. It does not say the bread is right there or that he never touches it.
The text does not say every bird pictured has nobody around. It also says he lies awake, but does not specify that it is night.
The man says he is like a lone bird; the explanation says he sits there as a bird.
The appointed time has come, but the psalm does not say that all waiting is over.
The man calls for this to be written; the verse does not say he is writing it himself.
The verse does not say the groaning was quieter than a boast or that the LORD heard it despite its quietness.
The verse does not explicitly identify the prisoner whose groaning is heard as one of those released.
